content:
Meryer (Shanghai) Chemical Technology Co., Ltd. is a reputable and rapidly growing chemical enterprise headquartered in the Minhang District of Shanghai, China—a dynamic hub for innovation, advanced manufacturing, and international trade. Established with a strong commitment to scientific excellence, sustainable development, and customer-centric solutions, Meryer specializes in the research, development, production, and distribution of high-purity specialty chemicals, fine chemical intermediates, and customized reagents for diverse industrial applications. Its product portfolio serves key sectors including pharmaceuticals, agrochemicals, electronics, materials science, and academic research—supporting R&D laboratories, contract manufacturers, and industrial-scale production facilities across China and globally.  

The company operates state-of-the-art GMP-compliant production facilities and analytical laboratories equipped with advanced instrumentation (e.g., HPLC, GC-MS, NMR), ensuring stringent quality control, batch traceability, and compliance with international standards such as ISO 9001 and relevant REACH/ICH guidelines. Meryer places strong emphasis on green chemistry principles, continuously optimizing synthetic routes to minimize environmental impact and enhance energy efficiency. Its R&D team—comprising experienced chemists and chemical engineers—collaborates closely with universities, research institutes, and industry partners to drive innovation in catalysis, chiral synthesis, and functional materials. With bilingual technical support, agile logistics, and a responsive supply chain, Meryer has earned a trusted reputation for reliability, transparency, and technical partnership. As China’s chemical industry evolves toward higher value-added and sustainable practices, Meryer (Shanghai) stands as a forward-looking, locally rooted yet globally connected contributor to scientific advancement and industrial progress.
